title: HumanReviewAuthorization
description: One line of the APPEND-ONLY audit event log <base>.review-authorizations.jsonl (+ .md): the reviewer's explicit authorization to resume downstream processing for one decision set (FR-077, research §22.4). Written on 'Continue processing' (interactive) or `review authorize` (scripting) — NOT by resolving the last review item. It records a HUMAN ACTION, so it is NOT part of the FR-053a run-twice deterministic-core artifact-equality set (audit remediation M4). Its body carries no wall-clock / random id (project convention) so re-authorizing an unchanged decision set is an IDEMPOTENT NO-OP APPEND. AUTHORIZATION VALIDITY IS EXACTLY `authorized_run_id == current run_id` (M2) — there is no queue-file hash. Each append is an atomic whole-file publish (M3).

authorized_run_id.description: The run_id this authorization is bound to. A successful delivery REQUIRES an authorization event whose authorized_run_id equals the delivered artifacts' run_id (FR-072 / FR-077). Changing any decision ⇒ new run_id ⇒ no event matches ⇒ the run is resolved_unauthorized again.

applicable_resolution_digest.description: sha256 over the sorted (applicability_key, canonical_json(selected)) pairs of the CURRENTLY-APPLICABLE resolution set replayed for this run (research §14). Audit evidence + a redundant cross-check of authorized_run_id.

resolved_item_ids.description: AUDIT EVIDENCE ONLY (M2) — the queue-item ids that were `resolved` at authorization time. NOT a validity gate: the derived run_state precedence already makes a newly raised item win (run_state=unresolved) regardless of a prior authorization.

authorized_via.description: interactive_continue: the reviewer chose 'Continue processing' in the interactive terminal workflow. cli_authorize: `solari-convert review authorize`. Both require zero open items and are equally binding; both are keyed to run_id.
